reference.title: Scenario 9 — Three-level deep nested Numbered list in Workflow
reference.shortdesc: Consider a numbered list that represents a workflow with nested phases, sub-phases, and sub-items.

section.p: Consider a numbered list that represents a workflow with nested phases, sub-phases, and sub-items.

section.p: Result: The converter maps all three numbering levels as nested ordered lists — Level 0 becomes the parent <ol>, Level 1 becomes a nested <ol>, and Level 2 becomes a further nested <ol> inside the Level 1 <li>.
